title: The Square
caption: Omelas on the morning of the Festival of Summer.

evening.means: 0 — the festival morning, the sun high behind the viewer; 1 — the festival evening: the sun gone, the sky deep blue with the afterglow over the sea, the garland lanterns lit

objects.name: The water spilling from the bowl

prompts.text: A solo wooden flute, bright and unhurried, a girl playing on a fountain's rim on a summer morning
Distant church bells ringing one after another over a white city by the sea, festive and airy
Light pastoral strings and harp, sunlit, a festival procession far off
Medieval dance on recorders and frame drum, joyful, a summer fair
Celtic harp arpeggios, clear water, morning light
A lonely flute melody with a quiet drone, a hint of sadness under the joy
Mediterranean guitar and mandolin, a square in the sun
Choir humming softly, no words, open fifths, sacred and calm
Glockenspiel and celesta, sparkling, children's festival
Low cello note held under bright woodwinds, something unspoken beneath
Pan flute and gentle hand percussion, a mountain festival
Hurdy-gurdy and fiddle, a slow folk waltz at evening with lanterns
Ambient seaside: gulls, wind over the bay, soft tonal pads
Solo piano, sparse and luminous, Satie-like, a white town at noon
Renaissance lute, a simple tender melody
Woodwind quintet, playful and light, horses in ribbons trotting by
